Before this season, the Warriors' worst start with Curry was when they went 1-5 to open the 2019-20 season, which is remembered for being the year they were recovering from losing Kevin Durant to free agency and Klay Thompson to an ACL tear before Curry broke his hand in the fourth game. But even in that season, they won their third game.

stories.title: The Stone Roses showed me the power of being an introvert
stories.summary: At boarding school in the early 90s, quietness was seen as weakness. But then I saw the band’s guitarist John Squire making a vast noise while hiding behind a fringe – and learned the strength of understatement I n September 1991, I had just been thrown into the meat-grinder of a Midlands boarding school. In this bear pit, there were predators and there was prey. You were either the swaggering rugby alpha, whipping a wet towel at pale bodies in the eight-boy dormitory; or the homesick ghost, keeping your guard up, endlessly braced for your toilet cubicle to be kicked open or your washbag chucked off the fire escape.

Sometimes it was one guy, who rambled like a metronome: On bigger, national games, you got a second announcer. Police in the south German state of Bavaria have detained a suspect during a fire at Adolf Hitler's Alpine mountain retreat, the Kehlsteinhaus, also known as the Eagle's Nest. Dispatchers in Traunstein received a fire alarm from the building at 21:15 (19:15 GMT) on Friday, and firefighters found it engulfed in flames. Difficult terrain was hindering efforts to extinguish the blaze and it was still burning early on Saturday, police said, with some 200 emergency personnel deployed. There were no reports of injuries.
